33 O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out! 34 For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor? - Romans 11:33-34 (KJV)

 What true statements these are, as the wisdom and knowledge of God are so great, that there is really no end to it. If you will study the bible (God’s Word) you will find out, that with the help of the Holy Spirit, you can continue to learn new truths every time you read a passage. The depth of God’s wisdom has no end, as you just keep getting new thoughts every time you read the bible. Of course you must be born again (John 10:9-10), and have the Holy Spirit within you, or you will not be able to understand the things of God. If you need help understanding how to be saved, visit our web site and the link “The Gospel”, and it will help you to know what to do for salvation.

 Even though we, who are born again, have the very mind of Christ in our new spirits (1 Corinthians 2:16), we can not fully access it. We now only see as looking through a dark glass (1 Corinthians 13:12), but when we see Jesus again, we will know all things. Until He comes again, we have the bible to study, and as we get new revelations we come closer and closer to knowing the truths of His Word. I encourage you to visit our web site and read our “New Revelations” web page, as the Lord has been revealing some new truths to us that have not been known to us before. Praise God, that He has given us His Word, and the Holy Spirit to help us understand it. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

Man, I dunno. On the one hand this looks like it HAS to be a joke, but on the other, that lady who was going to "live on light" seriously believed in it and went 47 days without food.

and went 47 days without food

Claiming she did and it actually being true are two different things.
this is true, but I think she was being monitored medically and ended up losing a substantial amount of weight and started showing signs of liver damage, if i remember correctly.

Well, you're going to need a bit more specific because the case i know about a lady starting to show signs of of kidney or liver damage only lasted 4 days before she had to get medical assistance. Of course you could be talking about a person that still maintained that drinking water everyday doesn't count, so that would mean the 47 days figure would be perfectly be in line with how long a person can go without food until they deplete their body protein reserves and the water they ingest won't cut it anymore until they die of starvation.

So, the point stands that without anything at all to eat, including water, no one has ever gone over a week without dying and with just water, no more than less than 10 weeks (i'm being generous with these numbers). What we end up with is with really delusional people making irrational claims, often times putting their lives in danger or dying and in other documented cases, resorting to deceit to sustain the lie.

The lady's name, or at least what she called herself, was Naveena Shine. I believe her youtube channel is called living on light, and that's where she allegedly vlogged her experiences of those 47 days. She claims she only consumed pretty much water or tea, I think, and was trying to prove that after she went without food long enough, she'd basically start photosynthesizing. Obviously kind of a kook, and I'm pretty much just going off my recollection of the news reports at the time.
